passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: .” B. Bu siness Overview The Viking Difference 1. One Brand : Among our guests and across the industry, the Viking brand is synonymous with excellence. Our guests can experience all three categories of the cruise industry—ocean, river and expedition cruising—under our single brand. Rather than creating a conglomerate of different brands, all of our products are a consistent extension of the Viking brand. As a result, our marketing spend and strong brand loyalty drive growth for all of our products. We also leverage our strong brand loyalty for future product launches, with over 60% of bookings for each of the inaugural seasons for Viking Ocean, Viking Expedition and Viking Mississippi made by past guests. Our guests know they can expect a consistent, excellent experience on each voyage they take with us, which has allowed us to expand our travel platform successfully with new destinations and experiences. Our repeat guest percentage has steadily increased over time from 27% for the 2015 season to 54% for the 2025 season. 2. Nearly Identical Small Ships : Our fleet includes 59 Longships accommodating 190 passengers, 12 ocean ships, including the Viking Yidun , accommodating 930 or 998 passengers and two expedition ships accommodating 378 passengers. Within each product, our ships are nearly identical and indistinguishable to our guests. This simplifies the sales and marketing process and creates operational flexibility, as well as efficiencies around shipbuilding, maintenance and crew, which improves our margins. Our small ships can dock in ports where larger ships cannot, providing our guests more time ashore for cultural discovery and exploration and offering our guests experiences they cannot have with other cruise lines. 3. Clearly Defined, Destination-Focused Experience : We are the only cruise line offering experiences on all seven continents with itineraries across five oceans, 21 rivers and five lakes, and a focus primarily on destinations in Europe and the Mediterranean, rather than the Caribbean. We deliver a highly differentiated experience for our guests by prioritizing exploration of the destination versus onboard consumption and traditional entertainment. The Viking experience is well-defined and all-inclusive, with a shore excursion included in every port. We are also known for the things that we do not do. For example, no children under 18, no casinos and no hidden ancillary costs, such as charges for alternative restaurants, wi-fi or beer and wine at lunch and dinner. Because of these strategic choices, our guests instantly recognize the Viking way of travel. 4. Clear Customer Focus : We are intently focused on the travel needs of our core demographic of curious, affluent, English-speaking travelers aged 55 years and older, which is an attractive segment of the travel market. We believe we know our core demographic better than anyone else in the industry and we have tailored our products to specifically address the travel needs of the Thinking Person. We attract individuals seeking travel experiences that offer cultural insight and personal enrichment. 5. Strong Direct Marketing : Since 1997, we have invested $3.6 billion in

credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded year over year and sits well above the sector median, reflecting a premium small-ship, destination-focused model with strong repeat guest demand and pricing power across ocean, river and expedition products.

Operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably and rose year over year, with cash conversion relative to borrowings above the sector median, supporting the minimal indicative financial risk profile on the cash-flow test.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage improved year over year but remains above the sector median, so the balance sheet carries more debt relative to earnings than peers despite the strong net cash position; the indicative profile is not a rating.

The debt note shows a large secured and unsecured note stack with nearer maturities alongside ship financings secured on specific vessels, so refinancing and collateral release depend on continued access to capital markets at acceptable spreads.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and stands well above one, but trails the sector median, indicating interest burden is heavier than peers even as operating income grows; coverage is adequate rather than strong.

Cash holdings are substantial relative to borrowings, leaving net leverage below the sector median and well inside the next risk-band boundary, which cushions refinancing risk on the nearer-dated notes and vessel loans.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer combines high operating margins, growing cash generation and a large cash buffer against a leveraged fleet-financing structure; net leverage is low relative to peers while gross leverage is above median, a profile consistent with the minimal indicative risk band.

Our forward view is that coverage and leverage headroom should hold if demand and pricing persist, but capital spending on newbuilds is not captured in the data, so free cash flow and distribution coverage remain unassessed and warrant monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 經營利潤率按年擴大，並遠高於行業中位數，反映以小型船舶、目的地為核心的高端模式，具備強勁的回头客需求，並在海洋、內河及探險產品上擁有定價能力。
經營現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋償債需求，並按年上升，現金轉換相對借款的比率高於行業中位數，支持現金流測試下的極低指示性財務風險狀況。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿按年改善，但仍高於行業中位數，因此儘管淨現金狀況強勁，資產負債表相對於盈利所承載的債務仍多於同業；指示性狀況並非評級。
債務說明顯示大量有抵押及無抵押票據，較近到期日與以特定船舶作抵押的船舶融資並存，因此再融資及抵押品釋放取決於能否以可接受息差持續進入資本市場。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善，並遠高於一倍，但低於行業中位數，顯示即使經營收入增長，利息負擔仍較同業為重；覆蓋率屬足夠而非強勁。
現金持有量相對借款龐大，使淨槓桿低於行業中位數，並遠在下一風險區間邊界之內，為較近到期票據及船舶貸款提供再融資風險緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人結合高經營利潤率、增長的現金產生能力及龐大現金緩衝，對應槓桿化的船隊融資結構；淨槓桿相對同業偏低，而總槓桿高於中位數，此狀況與極低指示性風險區間一致。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若需求及定價持續，覆蓋率及槓桿緩衝應可維持，但新造船資本開支並未納入數據，因此自由現金流及分派覆蓋率仍未被評估，值得監察。
